Print spifa Posterior Samples

Source: R/spifa-methods.R
print.spifa.Rd

Prints a fitted spifa object (the output of spifa): model type, formula, data dimensions, MCMC settings, and a posterior summary table (via summary.spifa) – following the convention of rstan/rstanarm/brms/R2jags, which all show actual parameter estimates by default rather than just fit metadata.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'spifa'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class spifa, as returned by spifa.

...

Further arguments passed to methods (currently unused).

Value

Invisibly returns x.

Author

Erick A. Chacón-Montalván

Examples

data(ipixuna)
samples <- spifa(items ~ 1, data = ipixuna, nfactors = 3, ngp = 0, niter = 20)
samples
